name: Opus Quality Defensive
strategy: Cross-asset carry + trend stacking (crypto trend, equity momentum, covered-call income, managed-futures & commodity carry) with per-position stop-loss/take-profit discipline.
novelty: The return driver is carry + trend/momentum harvested across asset classes, not a low-beta stock or sector tilt. R1 picked quality/low-vol defensive equities and R2 held defensive factor ETFs plus an SMH short; both earned the low-volatility premium. This book earns trend continuation, option-writing income, and cross-asset carry gated by daily stops — and holds no shorts.

positions.thesis: Primary trend engine; spot avoids perp funding drag, stop caps crash risk.
Higher-beta crypto trend sleeve with wider stop.
US equity momentum factor - harvests trend continuation.
Covered-call Nasdaq income (~10% yield) - option-writing carry.
Managed-futures cross-asset trend/carry; long in the 2022 crash.
Broad commodity roll carry - real-asset diversification.

backtest.notes: Stops cut the 2022 crash to -1.5% vs SPY -20.4%; backtest never re-enters a stopped sleeve so it understates the weekly-reassessed live version. JEPI proxied JEPQ pre-2022-05.

outlook: Trend and carry drivers aligned into late 2026; daily stops convert crypto fat-tail risk into defined small losses.
